t2chat-2025.description: An open source chat app. It talks to several model providers and sticks with none of them.

mercor-work-2025.description: Mercor's marketplace for contract work. The survey, availability and verification flows are mine. I like making people fill things in.

valdle-2024.description: The official Valorant Discord asked for an arcade game for their community. I don't usually take requests.

kalidokit-2021.description: A face and pose tracking solver for MediaPipe and TensorFlow.js. It's yeemachine's project and I'm the second biggest contributor. I won't be explaining the maths.

infinity-2020.description: A utility bot for WhatsApp. The oldest thing on this page. I was already like this in 2020.

meowscript-2023.description: He calls it the purrfect programming language. I wrote it in Rust and I don't make puns. It runs in the browser too.

wa-sticker-formatter-2021.description: An npm package that makes WhatsApp stickers out of images and videos. The metadata is where my name goes.

owcsle-2024.description: An arcade game for the Overwatch Champions Series esports league. I made the game, so I don't lose at it.

langchain-llama-2023.description: Llama and Vicuna support for LangChain's Node.js library. Nobody asked me to. That never stops me.

aureolin-2021.description: A TypeScript web framework where routes are decorators. I put an @ on a method and it obeys.

gyan-pro-2024.description: A voice note app that runs on Llama 3 8B through Groq. Built so I never have to write anything down.

everycube-2026.description: Every possible Rubik's Cube position on one page. All 43 quintillion. I worked each one out from its number so I'd never have to store them. You will not reach the end.

wake-to-xbox-2026.description: A Windows tray app. I press one button on the controller and the PC wakes up as a console. I got tired of walking to the keyboard.

gyromouse-2026.description: A Windows tray app that turns a controller into a mouse. I tilt it and the cursor moves. I don't use the desk for much now.

yellow-watermelons-2026.description: A browser tool that turns the red watermelons in WhatsApp stickers yellow. He calls it a joke. I call it a correction.

synapse-2025.description: A speech to text demo. It writes down what you said and works out what you wanted. I usually know before you finish.

write-2025.description: A writing app with a rich text editor and themes. It works offline, which is where I do my best work.

owcs-stats-2024.description: Match and map stats for the Overwatch Champions Series, pulled from the Faceit API. I keep records of everyone.

gpt-functions-2023.description: An npm package. Describe a function in plain English and OpenAI writes it. I didn't write the function. I wrote the thing that makes it write the function.

ethereal-2022.description: A small programming language in Rust, with a REPL and a standard library. He made a cat one after. Mine came first.

wyndon-2021.description: A small HTTP server framework for Node, built around middleware. Every request goes through me first.

chess-node-2021.description: A chess rules library for Node. It reports everything that happens on the board. It doesn't let you cheat. I checked.

whatsapp-botto-2021.description: Two open source WhatsApp bots. Xre came first and Void was the rewrite. People forked them 263 times. I count that as followers.
